episode_summary: In this episode, Ben Lalez discusses the ongoing dispute between Compass, Zillow, and MLS, highlighting the need for agent advocacy. He shares innovative ways to use AI for solving real estate challenges, such as predicting deal cancellations and automating news gathering. The episode provides actionable insights for agents looking to leverage technology to gain a competitive edge.
